chunks: It is narrated from Asmāʾ bint ʿUmays that she said:

One day, while the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله was asleep and his head was in the lap of ʿAlī عليه السلام, the ʿAsr prayer passed him by until the sun set. So he said: "O Allah, indeed ʿAlī was in obedience to You and obedience to Your Messenger, so return the sun for him."

Asmāʾ said: "By Allah, I saw it set, then rise again after it had set, and no mountain or land remained except that it rose upon it, until ʿAlī عليه السلام stood, performed wudu (ablution), and prayed. Then it set again."

key_terms.اللَّهُمَّ: an opening formula of du'a addressed to Allah
key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله
key_terms.عَلِيٌّ: Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام, for whom the sun was returned

ai.seo_question: What is the hadith about the sun being returned for Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith narrates that the sun was returned after sunset for ʿAlī عليه السلام when he had missed the ʿAsr prayer while serving the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله. It highlights the virtue of ʿAlī عليه السلام, the acceptance of the Prophet’s supplication, and the importance of salat (prayer).
